svg.title: Version-aware DSL transpiler — incremental update flow
svg.desc: Two schema versions feed into a schema diff engine. The diff flows into a multi-target codegen dispatcher producing SQL migrations, Servant/ORM updates, Datalog+QML changes, and LiquidHaskell+OpenAPI patches.

g.text: generateIncremental :: UTCTime → ERPSchema → SchemaDiff → IO GeneratedOutput
